skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.watched.desc: Keep a target in your crosshair while it hasn't noticed you and your next blow builds up to half again as hard (a quarter at rank 1). It is lost the moment the target notices you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.the_stare.desc: Sneak and hold your gaze on a target that hasn't noticed you for three seconds: a player's sight closes in to darkness, a mob sees much less far for a while.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.slip_behind.de: Tap sneak just before a blow lands (with no guard up): it finds nothing, and you stand behind whoever struck. Slow to come round again.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.body_count.des: Each kill you make from hiding soon after the last heals a little more than the one before.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.lift_weapon.de: A pickpocket's hand closes on the weapon a villager or guard holds, not their purse. If someone sees, it is theft.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.dry_remark.des: Knife form: say something cutting. Anyone of a weak temperament nearby drops what they hold.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.disarm_rush.de: Knife form: rush through up to three armed foes ahead, knocking the weapon from each hand. Players only drop the held item.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_disarm_rush.de: Weapon Form (knife). Rush through up to three armed foes ahead of you, knocking the weapon from each hand.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.form_dry_remark.des: Weapon Form (knife). A cutting word: those of weak temperament nearby let go of what they hold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.disarmed: %s knocks the weapon from your hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.remark.0: Nice grip. Shame about the rest.
message.jaymoskingdoms.remark.1: Careful, you might hurt yourself with that.
message.jaymoskingdoms.remark.2: Is that sharp end meant to face me?
message.jaymoskingdoms.lasso.roped: A rope has you. Struggle to break free.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lasso.player_up: Only someone who is down can be bound.
